{{Build | profession = warrior | specialization = berserker | designed for = open world, open world general | focus = strike damage | rating = great | meta = yes | xpac = hot | difficulty = 2 }} ==Overview== Power {{Tooltip|Berserker}} is a high damage and reliable build for open world that also provides boons. You'll spend most of the time in {{Skill|Berserk}} mode, dealing increased damage and killing enemies by spamming the Primal Burst skills {{Skill|Arc Divider}} and {{Skill|Wild Throw}} which will also provide permanent {{Tooltip|Quickness}}, {{Tooltip|Fury}} and some {{Tooltip|Might}} to yourself and nearby allies due to {{Trait|Heat the Soul}}. Berserker is also very relentless, having 2 stunbreak skills that also help with damage, and a heal skill that makes you nigh-immortal for a few seconds. However, it lacks ranged damage. ==Template Code== {{TemplateCode| code = [&DQIEGQsVEhnyEvIS1xKtAKgA1xKvAKgAwhKcAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAACCQEyAAA=] }} ==Skill Bar== {{Skill bar |profession = warrior |specialization = berserker |weapon1 = Greatsword |weapon2 = |weapon3 = Spear |weapon4 = |healing = Blood Reckoning |utility1 = Outrage |utility2 = "For Great Justice!" |utility3 = Signet of Fury |elite = Head Butt }} ===Weapon Variants=== {{Tooltip|Axe|Greatsword}} + {{Tooltip|spear}} is the default setup. Usage of {{Tooltip|spear}} requires Janthir Wilds. * {{Tooltip|Axe}} + {{Tooltip|Axe}} - replaces spear for players without Janthir Wilds or players that don't like spear. * {{Tooltip|Rifle}} - low damage at range if ranged damage is needed. An option for players without access to spear. ===Skill Variants=== ====Heal Skills==== {{Skill|Blood Reckoning}} is key to the build, letting you reset your Primal Burst and giving you adrenaline. Do not replace it. ====Utilities==== We recommend the following skills:
{{Skill|Outrage}} is extremely useful as a stunbreak that also extends the duration of your {{Skill|Berserk}} mode. Never replace it.
{{Skill|"For Great Justice!"}} provides you and nearby allies with boons. Very useful, but can be replaced if needed.
{{Skill|Signet of Fury}} is taken only for the passive increased precision and should never be activated. It can be replaced with {{Sigil|Superior Sigil of Accuracy}} on your weapons, or by eating food with +70 precision + 4 Precise infusions.
Other options you can consider are: * {{Skill|"Shake It Off!"}} - condition removal and stunbreak. * {{Skill|Wild Blow}} - good damage, daze, Berserk extension, removes certain conditions, and fury generation. * {{Skill|Signet of Stamina}} - more dodges and condition removal. ====Elite Skills==== {{Skill|Head Butt}} is absolutely key to the build and should never be replaced. It lets you start fights with full adrenaline, deals good damage, breaks stun, deals good crowd control, and extends the duration of {{Skill|Berserk}} mode. ==Specializations== {{Specialization|Strength|top|mid|top}} {{Specialization|Tactics|top|top|top}} {{Specialization|Berserker|top|mid|top}} ===Variants=== * {{Trait|Peak Performance}} - consider this for a small damage boost at the cost of stability. * {{Trait|Great Fortitude}} - use it when playing in groups giving you {{Tooltip|Might}} and {{Tooltip|Alacrity}}. * {{Trait|Might Makes Right}} - provides high self healing at the cost of damage, great synergy with certain food as explained in the food section below. * {{Trait|Blood Reaction}} - use it when playing in groups and someone else is already giving {{Tooltip|Quickness}}. ====Discipline==== {{Tooltip|Discipline}} should replace Tactics for players using {{Tooltip|Axe}}, as the trait {{Trait|Axe Mastery}} is mandatory for that build. {{Specialization|Discipline|mid|bot|top|variant=y}} * Use {{Trait|Destruction of the Empowered}} when playing in groups. ==Equipment== :Ascended gear and stat infusions are not required; you can use exotic gear with the same stats.
This set uses gear similar to [[Build:Berserker_-_Power_DPS]], making it good for general PVE. {{PvE equipment | weight = Heavy | stats = Berserker | rune = Superior Rune of the Scholar | rune-qt = 6 | weapon1 = Greatsword | weapon2 = | sigil1 = Superior Sigil of Force | sigil2 = Superior Sigil of Impact | weapon3 = Spear | weapon4 = | sigil3 = Superior Sigil of Force | sigil4 = Superior Sigil of Impact | relic = Relic of the Claw }} Usage of {{Tooltip|spear}} requires Janthir Wilds. {{Tooltip|greatsword}} is a great alternative. Spear and greatsword are very simmilar in terms of damage so use whichever you like more. If using {{Tooltip|greatsword}} AND {{Tooltip|spear}}, replace {{Tooltip|Discipline}} with {{Tooltip|Tactics}} as indicated in the traits section. * Note that having 60% critical chance before {{Tooltip|Fury}} and before {{Trait|Smash Brawler}} is absolutely mandatory. This is why you need either {{Skill|Signet of Fury}}; or {{Sigil|Superior Sigil of Accuracy}} replacing Force; or to eat food with +70 precision like {{Food|Plate of Coq Au Vin with Salsa}} together with 4 Precise +5 Agony Infusion. * Other relic alternatives include {{Relic|Relic of Zakiros}} to trade a minor amount of damage for sustain, or {{Relic|Relic of the Thief}} for steady damage. ==Consumables== Budget consumables are acceptable for use in open world. ===DPS=== * Prioritize '''Steak''' Ascended food. * {{Food|Plate of Spicy Moa Wings}} / {{Food|Bowl of Sweet and Spicy Butternut Squash Soup}} * {{Utility|Superior Sharpening Stone}} / {{Utility|Tin of Fruitcake}} ===Defense=== * {{Food|Bowl of Orrian Truffle and Meat Stew}} * {{Food|Fried Oyster Sandwich}} * {{Food|Bowl of Lemongrass Mussel Pasta}} * {{Food|Fried Golden Dumpling}} can be combo'd with {{Trait|Might Makes Right}} for insane self-healing. ===Farming=== * Prioritize '''Steak''' Ascended food. * {{Item|Birthday Blaster}} / {{Item|Feast of Delectable Birthday Cake}} * {{Food|Peppermint Omnomberry Bar}} * {{Utility|Sharpening Skull}} (and variants) ==Usage== ===Berserk=== {{Skill|Berserk}} is the profession mechanic of the berserker. After filling your Adrenaline bar, for example by using {{Skill|Head Butt}}, activate the skill to enter Berserk. In Berserk mode, you deal additional damage thanks to {{Trait|Fatal Frenzy}} and {{Trait|Bloody Roar}}, and have increased critical chance due to {{Trait|Smash Brawler}}. Your maximum Adrenaline is reduced, so it's easier to gain full Adrenaline to use the improved Primal Burst skills {{Skill|Arc Divider}} and {{Skill|Wild Throw}} which are your sources of {{Tooltip|Quickness}} from {{Trait|Heat the Soul}}. For these reasons, maintaining Berserk mode is key to playing berserker correctly. {{Skill|Blood Reckoning}}, {{Skill|Outrage}} and {{Skill|Head Butt}} extend its duration, and Primal Bursts too due to {{Trait|Smash Brawler}}. Thanks to this, you can maintain permanent Berserk mode during fights. ===Damage=== This build is very simple to play. Start fights by instantly filling your Adrenaline bar with {{Skill|Head Butt}}, activate {{Skill|Berserk}}, and pummel your enemies. Note that having 60% critical chance before {{Tooltip|Fury}} and before {{Trait|Smash Brawler}} is absolutely mandatory. ;Opener #{{Skill|Head Butt}} #{{Skill|Berserk}} #{{Skill|Wild Throw}} #{{Tooltip|Weapon swap}} #{{Skill|Arc Divider}} + {{Skill|Blood Reckoning}} + {{Skill|Arc Divider}} In short, spam your Primal Bursts. Use {{Skill|Blood Reckoning}} to cast {{Skill|Arc Divider}} twice back to back, then a third time when it recharges, and swap back to spear. * Use {{Skill|Head Butt}} + {{Skill|Outrage}} when your weapon skills are on cooldown to help maintain Berserk. * Use {{Skill|"For Great Justice!"}} before starting fights, and periodically throughout them. * If using Axes, the playstyle is slightly different. ** Your goal is to stay on {{Tooltip|axe}} and spam {{Skill|Eviscerate}} while using as little other skills in between as possible. Since {{Trait|Axe Mastery}} gives extra Adrenaline, including to {{Skill|Eviscerate}}, you only need to strike 3 times in between each {{Skill|Eviscerate}}. Be mindful that {{Skill|Cyclone Axe}} strikes twice, as does your second basic attack {{Skill|Double Chop}}. This means that, even if all your other skills are on cooldown, you are never going to cast your third auto attack {{Skill|Triple Chop}} because the first two auto attacks will have already filled your Adrenaline bar to use {{Skill|Eviscerate}}. ** After using your {{Tooltip|Axe}} skills, prepare your Adrenaline and swap to {{Tooltip|spear}} to cast {{Skill|Wild Throw}} + {{Skill|Blood Reckoning}} + {{Skill|Wild Throw}}, all skills except {{Skill|Spear Swipe}} unless needed, use {{Skill|Wild Throw}} a third final time, and swap back to axe. Repeat when {{Skill|Blood Reckoning}} comes off cooldown. ===Boon generation=== By spamming your Primal Bursts as detailed above, you will provide yourself and nearby allies with permanent {{Tooltip|Quickness}} and {{Tooltip|Fury}} and some {{Tooltip|Might}} due to {{Trait|Heat the Soul}}. You also provide yourself lots of short duration {{Tooltip|Might}} thanks to {{Trait|Forceful Greatsword}}, and some more with {{Skill|"For Great Justice!"}}. ===Defense=== * {{Skill|Whirlwind Attack}} can be used to evade attacks and reposition. * {{Skill|Blood Reckoning}} heals you based on damage dealt, continue to deal damage. * {{Skill|Head Butt}} and {{Skill|Outrage}} are stunbreaks. ===Crowd Control=== * {{Skill|Head Butt}} * {{Skill|Wild Blow}} * {{Skill|Disrupting Throw}}
